593:t_009:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「Watch out, $$バナージ$$! The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are coming!」

593:t_010:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Of all times for a pest like that to show up...!」

593:t_010:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「They have nothing to do with either us or $$クロノ$$.」

593:t_010:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「A three-way fight in this situation?!」

593:t_010:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バアル$$, the metallic life forms?!」

593:t_010:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! This is no time for us to be fighting each other!」

593:t_010:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is that how you plan to run away?!」

593:t_010:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「His heart is being shut away even more tightly by the $$バンシィ$$'s system...」

593:t_010:10.en:
$$フォウ$$
「If we do not stop that thing, he will...!」

593:t_010:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So it is a psycho machine that warps people...」

593:t_010:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Not to something like that!」

593:t_010:13.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Hurry, $$バナージ$$! The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are heading for Ensign $$リディ$$ too!」

593:t_010:15.en:
$$シン$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ can't see anyone but you! At this rate he'll get fused!」

593:t_010:16.en:
$$キラ$$
「Stop the Ensign before that happens!」

593:t_011:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_011:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, keep the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ away from the $$バンシィ$$!」

593:t_011:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「So you are coming, $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_011:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! You were fighting for $$オードリー$$ too, weren't you!」

593:t_011:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's why I'm going to stop you! As a comrade... as a man who fought with the same feelings!」

593:t_012:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's stop this, Ensign $$リディ$$!」

593:t_012:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「You went easy on me so you wouldn't kill me?!」

593:t_012:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「You...! How miserable do you have to make me before you're satisfied?!」

593:t_012:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「A kid like you, flattered as a $$ニュータイプ$$, stirring everything up!」

593:t_012:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$...! A subspecies of humanity that embodies the curse of $$ラプラスの箱$$...! Somebody has to be the human sacrifice to quell it!」

593:t_012:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$マーセナス家$$ that left the curse behind, and the $$ビスト家$$ that kept hiding it...!」

593:t_012:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「Only we, who each inherit one of them, can settle this feud!」

593:t_012:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「It wasn't supposed to be like this...! That was never a curse, it was a prayer! If only $$ニュータイプ$$s had never been born!」

593:t_012:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Calm down, $$リディ$$! The machine is swallowing you up!」

593:t_012:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「So what?! I'm out to defeat a new humanity that is trying to evolve! Selling my soul to a machine is nothing...!」

593:t_012:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$! Open your heart more!」

593:t_012:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't you understand, Ensign $$リディ$$?!」

593:t_012:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're a $$ニュータイプ$$ too! The light of the $$バンシィ$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ is coming from inside you!」

593:t_013:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are drawn to those who emit $$脳量子波$$. Perhaps it was your strong feelings that called them.」

593:t_013:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「And you have the power to master that $$バンシィ$$.」

593:t_013:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You must be able to hear it! Everyone is worried about you! $$オードリー$$, Ensign $$ミヒロ$$ and the others too!」

593:t_013:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Then I won't use words... But even so... even so...!)

593:t_013:8.en:
$n
(Ensign, you always made time for my special training. Let me repay you for that!)

593:t_013:9.en:
$$キラ$$
(For Her Highness $$ミネバ$$, you were ready to throw away your own life and fight. You're the same as us...!)

593:t_013:10.en:
$$エマ$$
(Where did you go, the you who tried to prove yourself without relying on the $$マーセナス家$$?!)

593:t_013:11.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(A pilot lives by his own skill alone! Family, blood, to hell with all that!)

593:t_013:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(You were always looking ahead, weren't you!)

593:t_013:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Don't let that talent go to waste!)

593:t_013:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
(You're not a man who should end here!)

593:t_014:0.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(You know in your heart what you have to do now...)

593:t_014:2.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(Lend your strength to $$バナージ$$... to us... and to the future of humanity.)

593:t_014:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's an illusion, this...! The $$サイコミュ$$ is picking up people's stray thoughts!」

593:t_014:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(The machine is only amplifying them. That $$バンシィ$$ is also a beast of possibility...)

593:t_014:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(It has a system that responds to people's hearts...)

593:t_014:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「People's hearts... hearts can reach each other...?」

593:t_014:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You saw it too at $$アクシズ$$! People's hearts gathering in the machine!」

593:t_014:10.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
(Come back to who you really are, Ensign $$リディ$$! Don't hurt yourself any more!)

593:t_014:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「All of you...! All of you are going to deny me?!」

593:t_016:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, what are you doing?!」

593:t_017:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you're going to get in my way, I'll take you down too!!」

593:t_017:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ミネバ$$...! You... me...! I told you not to leave me alone!」
